payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count runs of consecutive empty seats in rows and columns; increment answer for each run of at least k. If k=1, divide by 2 to avoid double counting.
payload.rationale: The code does a complete scan to enumerate all segments of length k that are all empty. Among given subtypes, search_permutation_enumeration is the closest, though it is not really permutation enumeration. Confidence is low due to mismatch in algorithm nature.
